Incorrect and, at times, dangerously inaccurate information was recorded in my medical notes, by him, which later had to be formally corrected. This is particularly concerning given that I now have multiple formally diagnosed, complex health conditions after years of being dismissed and gaslit within the NHS. Despite these confirmed diagnoses, I am still treated as though my conditions are not real or not medically established.

Out of three doctors we have encountered at this practice, only one, a male doctor who attends intermittently from London, has provided competent and respectful care for my daughter. The rest of our experiences have been extremely poor.

One female doctor, I think named Dr Galan, told me that she had never heard of palpitations being associated with anaemia and suggested the symptoms were “in my head.” This is not only dismissive but factually incorrect. Palpitations are clearly listed as a common symptom of iron deficiency anaemia on the NHS website, in addition to being associated with several of my other diagnosed conditions. Even a receptionist at the practice was aware of this. Imagine being told it is in your head when the last time my Transferrin saturation was checked it was 7% and just before 4%. This is very low, and would account for many symptoms, no one needs a doctorate to figure that out.

On multiple occasions, letters have been sent from A&E requesting follow-up or support, yet I have received no response. As a result, I am now managing aspects of my health independently simply to avoid further distress from interacting with this practice.

I am actively hoping to move and no longer be registered here. I would not recommend this surgery to patients with complex or chronic health conditions who require informed, compassionate, and accurate medical care. the bottom of my heart, I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at the surgery.

After being unwell for over 10 days, I contacted the surgery during what I know is one of the most difficult and pressured times of the year for GP practices. From the very first moment, the reception team were absolutely exceptional. They listened to me with kindness, patience, and genuine care, making me feel heard and supported when I was feeling at my weakest.

I had already been advised by a pharmacist and by NHS 111 to seek urgent GP advice, and the receptionists acted quickly and compassionately to ensure a doctor contacted me as soon as possible. Their calm reassurance and efficiency made an enormous difference and immediately gave me confidence that I was in safe hands.

The doctor then asked me to attend the surgery, where I was thoroughly assessed and diagnosed with pneumonia. Thanks to their professionalism and prompt action, I was able to start antibiotics straight away, and I am now on the road to recovery.

I truly believe that without the care, understanding, and swift response from this surgery, my condition could have been far worse. The kindness shown to me was not just medical care — it was genuine human care, and it meant more than words can express.

Thank you for being there when I needed you most.
